europe_now.title: Russian Hybrid Threats and Security Concerns
europe_now.summary: European leaders have issued warnings regarding an intensified threat level from Russian hybrid attacks and security challenges across the region. In response to these growing concerns, French authorities have ordered specific measures to protect critical infrastructure against ongoing threats.

sources.headline: 🔴 Macron orders plan to protect France critical infrastructure against 'Russian hybrid attacks'

europe_now.title: Electoral Developments in Russia
europe_now.summary: Polling stations have opened across Russia as citizens participate in parliamentary elections under strict political control. Observers note that these votes proceed with virtually no remaining facade of genuine political opposition.

top_stories.title: European Defense Initiatives
top_stories.summary: Poland has officially joined the European Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition to enhance regional defense capabilities. Meanwhile, procurement and cooperative security plans continue to evolve across several European states.
